text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rushed an injured Durandal to the 
nurse's office in a great hurry.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Kh... What an absolute blunder...!
choice_data_list:
Let's focus on healing your injury for 
now.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...No, please let me continue my training.
choice_data_list: 今はケガを治すことに集中しよう

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Focusing solely on recuperation would 
expose a weakness to strong rivals. 
...Tactically speaking, that is not a wise 
move.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
To offer this victory to my master! Now is 
the time to show a knight's pride...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just light training, I don't 
mind. Please, let me continue!
choice_data_list: Let's not push ourselves too hard.

...If it's a light training menu, then 
maybe.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm certainly not pushing myself! As a 
proud knight, this much is nothing...!
choice_data_list: 無理をするのは止めよう
……負担が軽いメニューであれば

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Is it precisely because... she is a noble 
knight?
choice_data_list: 君が立派な騎士だからこそ、だよ
貴方が立派な騎士だからこそ、だよ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A seasoned knight can accurately assess 
the situation. Whether it is wise to push 
through and proceed or not.
choice_data_list: Try analyzing it calmly once more

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...There is a high probability the injury 
could worsen. Indeed, it is a risk we 
cannot overlook.
choice_data_list: 今一度、冷静に分析してみて

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I am sorry. I shall focus on resting and 
recuperating for a while.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. As a knight, I shall 
let no sign of distress show...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal goes for a jog on the soft dirt 
track, but..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If I quit now, they'll realize I'm 
injured...!
choice_data_list: それ以上は止めておこう

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pushing herself further might lead to an 
even worse injury. I persuaded her that 
this would put her at a far greater 
disadvantage than exposing a weakness.
choice_data_list: It takes courage to retreat, too

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.
choice_data_list: 撤退をする勇気も必要だよ

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
This is all due to my inexperience... I am 
terribly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal aggravated her injury and was 
forced to rest..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"When Durandal goes for a jog on the soft 
dirt track..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Phew...! Alright, it hardly hurts at all.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
With this, no one will realize she is 
injured.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal trained at a manageable pace and 
made a smooth recovery."
